description: This is a Python source file containing utility functions and logic for handling Italian-specific e-invoicing processes within the ERPNext framework. It includes functions for updating tax data, exporting invoices, preparing invoice data, validation, and file handling related to electronic invoicing, particularly tailored for Italy's fiscal regulations.

methods.name: update_itemised_tax_data(doc)
methods.description: Updates tax and amount details for each item in a sales or purchase document, based on itemised tax data.

methods.name: export_invoices(filters=None)
methods.description: Exports selected invoices into a ZIP file containing their electronic invoice XML attachments.

methods.name: prepare_invoice(invoice, progressive_number)
methods.description: Prepares and populates invoice data, including company, customer, tax, and address details, for e-invoicing.

methods.name: get_conditions(filters)
methods.description: Constructs filters for querying invoices based on provided date and company filters.

methods.name: download_zip(files, output_filename)
methods.description: Creates and serves a ZIP archive of given files for download.

methods.name: get_invoice_summary(items, taxes)
methods.description: Generates a summary of invoice taxes and charges, including VAT and other tax details, for e-invoice reporting.

methods.name: sales_invoice_validate(doc)
methods.description: Performs validation checks on a Sales Invoice document before e-invoice processing, ensuring required data and compliance.

methods.name: sales_invoice_on_submit(doc, method)
methods.description: Trigger function to validate payment details and prepare the invoice for e-invoicing upon submission.

methods.name: prepare_and_attach_invoice(doc, replace=False)
methods.description: Generates the e-invoice XML, attaches it as a File document to the Sales Invoice, and manages the filename and submission process.

methods.name: generate_single_invoice(docname)
methods.description: Generates and provides the URL for a single e-invoice XML file for a specific Sales Invoice.

methods.name: sales_invoice_on_cancel(doc, method)
methods.description: Removes e-invoice XML attachments when a Sales Invoice is canceled.

methods.name: get_company_country(company)
methods.description: Retrieves the country of the given company to determine if e-invoicing applies.

methods.name: get_e_invoice_attachments(invoices)
methods.description: Retrieves existing XML e-invoice files attached to invoices, filtered by company tax ID.

methods.name: validate_address(address_name)
methods.description: Checks that address records contain required fields like pincode, city, and country code.

methods.name: get_unamended_name(doc)
methods.description: Computes the base name of a document, excluding amendments.

methods.name: get_progressive_name_and_number(doc, replace=False)
methods.description: Generates a unique progressive name and number for the e-invoice, optionally replacing existing files.

methods.name: set_state_code(doc, method)
methods.description: Sets the state code based on the state's name, for Italy, using a predefined mapping.
